snippet.title: Planet Kepler 186F - Exclusive Trailer
snippet.description:
The lost signal of the Kepler-186F colonization project travels across the stars, and you, as an urgently activated crisis-response robot, land on this unknown alien planet.

The game is scheduled to be released on Steam in 2026.

Check STEAM page for more details:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4263880/_186F/

#Kepler186F #UnrealEngine5 #Gameplay
